$comment: Project-level (committed) Claude Code config for this template. Enforces the repo's golden rules and shared commit hygiene. This is UNIONED with each developer's ~/.claude settings; deny rules and hooks here always apply and cannot be loosened from user settings. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (git-ignored).
$comment_attribution: Keep commits authored by the human, not the agent. 'attribution' is the current key (blank commit/pr trailers); 'includeCoAuthoredBy' is the deprecated key, kept for older Claude Code versions.
$comment_hooks: Hook commands run through a shell, so the $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR expansion must stay double-quoted. Unquoted, a project path containing spaces (common for a monorepo cell, e.g. 'Applied ML/AI Agents/...') word-splits and the hook dies with exit 127 — which is not exit 2, so nothing is blocked and the guardrails silently do nothing. Do not remove the quotes.
